observations.observation: The complete tall page has a consistent centered prose column, a readable English title, three clearly separated sections (Parallel capacitors, Series capacitors, Different types of capacitor), equations, all five figure blocks and continuing prose through the final paragraph. At the displayed overview scale there is no visible text/figure collision, horizontal overflow, truncated page ending or blank figure block. Captions Figure 153 through Figure 157 remain separate and in sequence below their respective figures. Fine-glyph approval is limited by the automatic downsampling disclosed below.

The saved 1440-by-960 viewport shows the actual course title and introductory English definitions clearly, with comfortable line spacing and no overlapping or horizontally clipped text. The printed-page breadcrumb wraps 193 onto its own line without collision. Content continuing at the bottom is an ordinary viewport boundary, not evidence of page-content clipping. This image is reviewed for what it visibly contains, not for a polarization subject inferred from its filename.

The nonblank parallel-capacitor drawing fits inside its saved figure bounds. Both capacitor symbols, connecting strokes and terminal dots are visible. C1/C2 and the signed charge-magnitude labels, including their visible subscripts and bars, are legible and separated from the drawing and image edges. The Figure 153 caption is visible below the figure in the whole-page image; the isolated figure image does not include its caption.

The nonblank two-capacitor line drawing is fully framed with both symbols and the complete connecting line. Charge-magnitude labels above, U1/U2/U3 below and C1/C2 farther below are legible, uncropped and do not collide. The Figure 154 caption is visibly separate in the whole-page context.

The paper-capacitor package drawings, wound-layer spiral and layer-strip detail are nonblank and fully inside the figure bounds. Paper capacitors, Paper, Wound layers, Metal foil and Insulating paper are readable English labels. The leader lines lie close to the layer labels, but the words remain identifiable at this saved desktop scale; no obscured word or clipped object is apparent. Figure 155 is separately captioned in the whole-page context.

The air-variable-capacitor apparatus is nonblank and fully framed, including the top knob, supports, dense plate drawing and lower callouts. Air-variable capacitor, Fixed plates, Moving plates and Air gaps are readable and remain separated from the image edges and apparatus. Dense internal linework is visible without blank rendering; this is a display finding, not a new science or geometry verdict. Figure 156 remains separately captioned in the whole-page context.

The three external electrolytic-capacitor package examples are nonblank, fully framed and visually distinct. Electrolytic capacitors, Axial leads and Mounting stud are legible English labels with unobscured callouts. The whole-page English prose explicitly describes external packages rather than an internal cutaway and states that polarity and voltage rating cannot be inferred from this simplified illustration. No internal structure, polarity, numeric rating or terminal assignment is inferred by this review. Figure 157 is separately captioned and subsequent body text continues unobstructed.

limitations: The whole-page PNG was automatically displayed downsampled from 1440x9843 to 878x6000. It supports complete-course layout, section, caption and gross-clipping observations, not native-resolution certification of every body glyph, small equation, subscript or caption glyph. No crop, zoom, alternate image or reopen was used to overcome that limit.

Only these seven bound desktop saved PNGs were visually opened, once each. No mobile image, original source image, SVG, additional screenshot or browser was opened. This PASS is limited to the current bound desktop saved-pixel display.

The screenshot producer was isolated, offline and headless, with browserClosed true and zero requests in the bound report. This is not a headed product review, live production acceptance, interaction test or a claim about an authenticated learner session.

Chinese machine/source labels and Chinese figure ARIA labels are retained and disclosed by the bound report. Visible English body text, figure labels and captions do not establish a fully English accessibility tree.

No accessibility certification, screen-reader audit, keyboard audit or embedded-raster/fine-glyph certification is claimed. The bound report likewise does not claim complete English accessibility approval.

Complete source/science and EN82R1R4 PASS evidence is reused from the assignment, not independently replayed or reopened. This saved-pixel verdict does not replace those substantive approvals or authorize a broader complete-course content approval.
Figure 157 shows external packages, not an internal cutaway. Polarity and operating-voltage rating are not established by these pixels and were not inferred.
